01-07.event: Galileo Galilei discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter, the first moons found orbiting a planet other than Earth.

01-16.event: Soyuz 4 and Soyuz 5 performed the first docking of two crewed spacecraft in orbit.

01-27.event: The Outer Space Treaty, the foundational framework of international space law, was opened for signature.

02-03.event: The Soviet Luna 9 probe achieved the first successful soft landing on the Moon.

02-11.event: The LIGO collaboration announced the first direct detection of gravitational waves, from two colliding black holes.

02-15.event: The Chelyabinsk meteor exploded over Russia, the largest airburst since the 1908 Tunguska event.

02-18.event: Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto at Lowell Observatory.

02-20.event: John Glenn became the first American to orbit the Earth, aboard Friendship 7.

02-29.event: The Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity, having landed weeks earlier, continued surface operations on this rare leap day, part of a mission that would return unprecedented surface data from Mars.

03-06.event: NASA launched the Kepler space telescope to search for exoplanets.

03-14.event: Albert Einstein was born in Ulm, Germany.

04-12.event: Yuri Gagarin became the first human to travel into space, aboard Vostok 1.

04-24.event: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched aboard the Space Shuttle Discovery.

05-14.event: The United States launched Skylab, its first space station.

05-25.event: President Kennedy announced the goal of landing a man on the Moon before the end of the decade.

05-29.event: Arthur Eddington's solar eclipse expedition measured starlight bending around the Sun, providing early observational support for general relativity.

06-19.event: The Soviet Union carried out an early orbital rendezvous test as part of the Vostok program.

07-04.event: CERN announced the discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson, using data from the ATLAS and CMS experiments.

07-14.event: NASA's New Horizons spacecraft performed its closest flyby of Pluto, returning the first detailed images of the dwarf planet.

07-16.event: The Trinity test in New Mexico became the first detonation of a nuclear weapon.

07-20.event: Apollo 11 astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the Moon.

08-06.event: NASA's Curiosity rover landed on Mars.

08-25.event: Voyager 2 made its closest approach to Neptune, the only spacecraft to have visited the planet.

09-26.event: Soviet officer Stanislav Petrov judged a satellite warning of incoming nuclear missiles to be a false alarm, a decision credited with averting potential nuclear war.

10-04.event: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite to orbit Earth.

11-25.event: Albert Einstein presented the final field equations of general relativity to the Prussian Academy of Sciences.

12-02.event: The first self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction was achieved at Chicago Pile-1, part of the Manhattan Project.

12-14.event: Max Planck presented his quantum hypothesis to the German Physical Society, often marking the birth of quantum theory.

12-28.event: Wilhelm Röntgen submitted his paper announcing the discovery of X-rays.

02-02.event: Patrick Blackett published the first experimental results of nuclear transmutation, bombarding a nitrogen nucleus with an alpha particle to produce oxygen-17 and a proton, at the Cavendish Laboratory.

02-27.event: James Chadwick published his discovery of the neutron, identifying it as the mysterious 'beryllium radiation' previously observed by Irène and Frédéric Joliot-Curie.
